title: Cut sign-in from 4.5 to 2.8 minutes
about: Move the code step first and drop the second password screen. Umer signs in on a phone in under three minutes, with no new screens.

understood.label: You asked
understood.text: Make sign-in on a phone quicker for returning users.

understood.label: Done when
understood.text: A returning user is in the app within three minutes, measured on the real flow.

understood.label: Not in scope
understood.text: New sign-in methods and the desktop flow.

visual.heading: Sign-in takes 4.5 minutes today. The plan gets it to 2.8.
visual.text: Median minutes from the first screen to the home screen, over the last 200 phone sign-ins.

sections.heading: Two screens cost most of the time
sections.body: The code step sits behind a password screen that most users have saved in the keychain anyway.

items.title: Second password screen
items.text: 1.4 min median, and 31% of people leave here.
items.more: The screen asks again for what the keychain already filled in. It is the single slowest screen in the flow.

items.title: Code arrives late
items.text: The text message is sent after the password, so people wait for it.

sections.heading: Send the code first, then ask for the password once
sections.body: Two small changes, each shipped on its own, so either can be rolled back.

items.title: Send the code on the first tap
items.text: The text arrives while the password is typed.
items.more: No new screen. The code field moves above the password field and the message goes out when the email is entered.

items.title: Remove the second password screen
items.text: One password entry, kept by the keychain.

decisions.question: Ship to everyone, or to a tenth first?
decisions.why: A tenth first adds a week and shows any drop in sign-ins before it reaches everyone.

options.label: A tenth first
options.outcome: A week of data, then everyone.

options.label: Everyone at once
options.outcome: Live this week; a rollback is a redeploy.

decisions.reason: A drop in sign-ins costs more than a week.
decisions.quiet: I ship to a tenth on Thursday.

next.heading: I start with the code step as soon as you answer
